node.statement: Theorem 5.1: The action splits as I = I_{TT} + I_V + I_S with no cross-terms: I_{TT} = (1/4)∫(□h^{TT}_{ij})², I_V = -(1/2)∫V_i∇²□V_i, I_S = ∫(Φ*,ψ*)M(Φ,ψ)d⁴k/(2π)⁴ with M the 2×2 matrix. No cross-terms by Schur orthogonality for SO(3) irreps (spin-0, spin-1, spin-2). [Refs: Schur Orthogonality for SO(3) Irreps. Depends: 1.3, 1.4]
